question: Can exact source-video overlap between the pinned VideoPrism-B checkpoint's pretraining corpus and the AVATAR TRAIN videos used in the category-transfer probe be established?

target_data.upstream_media_source: VGGSound-derived YouTube videos; source-video copyright remains with original owners

pretraining_evidence.reported_scale: 36 million video-text pairs and 582 million video clips with noisy or machine-generated parallel text

overlap_assessment.reason: The AVATAR groups are YouTube video IDs. Official VideoPrism materials disclose broad source families, including YouTube video collections, but do not publish the full checkpoint-specific item-level source-ID manifest; some sources are private or subject to data wipeout. Therefore exact overlap and a zero-overlap claim cannot be tested.
overlap_assessment.inference: Potential source overlap is material, but no actual overlapping ID has been established by this audit.

result_disposition: Treat the AVATAR category-transfer result as a source-group-disjoint, category-held-out development diagnostic within AVATAR TRAIN whose VideoPrism pretraining overlap is unknown. Do not describe it as independent-source transfer evidence or tune again on its held categories.
